trans-unit.target: TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYSTEM_100_000<tab>In order to undertake this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYSTEM_110_000<tab>1. FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail must be registered to your service account. 2. You must be a beastmaster.
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYSTEM_120_000<tab>3. You must have completed the First Master's Board. 4. You must have befriended at least thirty beasts.
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYLMOND_000_000<tab>Your performance within the Crucible has been astounding. We're all in quite the ruffle!

TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYLMOND_000_001<tab>Lady Lauda not least of all. She has been most restless, most secretive of late... Why, it was only thanks to the keenest of my senses that I discovered she added yet another board!
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYLMOND_000_002<tab>A board upon which, I understand, Lady Lauda herself shall challenge you─together with Ser Guttler!
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYLMOND_000_003<tab>Can you believe it!? A return match like no other!
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYLMOND_000_004<tab>Your bout will no doubt feel personal, but you mustn't let your guard down. Those two may be nigh unstoppable with their powers combined.

TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYLMOND_000_005<tab>However, I have every faith that <var 1A 02 /var>you<var 1A 01 /var> will emerge the victor. Sally forth, <var 08 E905 ((Lady)) ((Ser)) /var> <var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>─to triumph!
TEXT_JOBXBM192_05501_SYSTEM_000_020<tab>The Second Master's Board has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.
